text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Wednesday as reported by the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The national conference is to be convened without pro-democratic parties.
- There is political restlessness ahead of the national conference on September 14 and 15.
- There have been intensive contacts between the presidency and the Islamist Hamas party which has set conditions for its participation in the conference.
- Algeria needs legislation to curb pollution and protect the environment.
